lines: Woman
「Hiiiiiiiiih??!! Don't come near me! Noooooooo!!」
Gusha!!!
Vicious claws were swung down at the face of a fleeing woman.
Fresh blood erupted.
Having had half of her face cleanly gouged out, the woman made a death scream and tumbled to the ground.
Her half-conscious body convulsed sporadically within a pool of blood.
Looking down upon that were grotesque monsters that were clearly unlike human beings.
Disproportionately huge bodies. Dark, flat, ulcerated faces. Cold eyes which gave no impression of a will, like those of a fish or amphibian.
They were also different from any of the non-human races who lurked in cities of darkness, such as demons and oni.
The monsters that had just attacked the woman were completely different “things” from the organisms of this world.
Man
『......You've put us to quite some trouble, water sprite girl.』
Woman
Seeing the man who had come into view, who appeared to be a sorcerer, the half-dead woman pleaded in a hoarse voice.
But, with no sign of listening to that voice, he took a strangely-ornamented knife out from his pocket, and
Guchaaa!!
Woman
「Agaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh?!!」
Man
The blade was plunged into the woman's lower abdomen.
Her distended stomach was slit top to bottom, and an amorphous lump of flesh was pulled out from inside it.
Woman
「Hiiiiiiih?!! Agah, aaaaaaaahhhhhhhh......!!」
It was a water-nix fetus.
The woman was of the group known as the sprites, positioned between demons and fairies, and had been carrying a water-nix child in her belly.
The sorcerer man carefully inspected what he had taken out, and finally put it away in a container like he was satisfied.
Man
『.........I've kept you waiting, my boys. Dispose of her as usual.』
「URUUUUUUUUUUUUU!!!!」
Having gotten the man's permission, the monsters tucked into the body of the woman whose stomach had been cut open.
The squishing, crunching sounds of flesh being bitten off.
Perhaps because she had already expired, her body no longer moved even a twitch.
The monsters ate up their “treat”, sinking their teeth into the places where the flesh was tender, and even sucking up the blood that had spilled onto the ground――
And that gruesome scene was being stared at fixedly from within the darkness by a foreign-looking girl.
The underground city of Yomihara.
That dark city, which was 300 metres below Tokyo, was covered in a white haze due to the rain that had suddenly begun to fall.
This was not normal rain, but “rain that had fallen in the past”.
Rain that had fallen to the ground would spend many years travelling through the earth, arrive here in Yomihara, and then dampen streets again.
Clone Asagi
「Honestly. Damned rain......」
In that rainy Yomihara was a woman, walking with a hood on to hide her appearance.
She was a detective.
A woman with the same face as Igawa Asagi, commander of all the Gosha Taimanin.
But, of course, it was not the real her.
She was a “clone” created from Igawa Asagi's cells.
A cyborg soldier formerly of Secret Service Agency “G”.

For certain reasons, she had been found by “G” and received the latest and strongest cyborg arm transplants, but she had harboured misgivings about their heavy-handed way of doing things, and taken flight.
At present, she was hiding in Yomihara, which was out of “G”'s reach, and was spending her days as a jack-of-all-trades and detective.
Clone Asagi
（Well, it's hard to say that the detective business is doing well, though......）
Clone Asagi sighed, as she was wetted by the rain.
What she had currently taken on was a bizarre case that had been causing a stir in the neighbourhood of late.
A few days earlier――
A female sprite's body had been found in a back alley in the slums of Yomihara.
It was a strange and gruesome corpse, which appeared to have had all the flesh on its body gnashed apart by sharp teeth.
The murdered sprite had been a pregnant woman, and her abdomen had been cut open, and its insides emptied――
Clone Asagi
This may have been an underworld city, where violence and homicide were an everyday occurrence, but incidents this horrible were rare.
Outraged to have their turf infringed upon, the boss of the slums had entrusted the matter to her, and an investigation had commenced.
――But, even after days of investigation, she hadn't been able to get any leads worth mentioning.
And once again today, she was about to return to the office after walking all over the city of darkness, with nothing whatsoever to show for it.
Yomihara, downtown.
On the corner of a busy street lined with cheap bars and whorehouses, there was an office that she was using as her base of operations.
Clone Asagi
When she got to the front of the office, noisy, squabbling voices became audible from inside.
Voice 1
「I'm. Telling. You. I'm not a child! Quit it! I'm gonna get angry!」
Voice 2
「So you say, but this is a dangerous town. I'd be worried if a little kid was all on her own.」
Voice 2
「Come on, where's your mom? I'll go look for her with you.」
Voice 1
「Mmmmmgh! Listen to meeee～!!!」
Clone Asagi
One of the voices she didn't have a clue about, but the other was a voice she knew well.
While sighing, “Dear, dear,” Clone Asagi opened the door.
Clone Asagi
「......What are you making a racket about, Aki? I could hear you from outside the door.」
Fuuma Aki
「Ohh, you're back, Detective?」
Little Girl
「What? She's the detective?! Then who are you?!」
Aki
「Me? I'm just the house-sitter.」
Little Girl
「House-sitter?!!」
A little girl made a stunned face.
It seemed that she had been under the misapprehension that Aki, who was in the office, was the detective.
Clone Asagi
「To be precise, it's more like she's settled in without asking.」
Clone Asagi added, making a wry smile.
Fuuma Aki was a swordfighting Taimanin, whom she had met on a previous job.
Though she was affiliated with Gosha, she was feared by those around her because of the power of her Evil Eye, and she seemed to frequently perform her missions solo.
She herself appeared to not have much interest in socializing with people, but got on well with Clone Asagi, strangely enough.
And so, when she had come to Yomihara, like this, she had decided that this office would be her base, and settled in without asking.
Little Girl
「Wh-What's with that?! Taking up residence in someone's house without permission? Don't you have any common sense?!」
Aki
「Hmm. When you put it that way, it's a little tough on me too, but...... This is unavoidable.」
Aki
「'Cause finding another base is a hassle.」
Little Girl
「O-Oi?! Did you hear that, Detective?! She just called it a hassle!」
The two of them started making a racket again, and Clone Asagi smiled exasperatedly.
Clone Asagi
「Well, I don't mind. As you can see, there's plenty of space, and I do occasionally have Aki help me with my work.」
Clone Asagi
「More importantly, about you. Do you have some kind of business with me?」
Little Girl
「Oh, right, right! If you're the detective, then let's cut to the chase. I'm a client!」
Little Girl
「I want you to find my lost familiar, Kuro!」
Clone Asagi
「Familiar......?」
Miriam
「Um-hmm! I'm in this form for certain reasons, but I'm actually the great witch, Miriam!!」
The girl puffed out her chest in front of the dumbfounded pair.
The little girl's――Miriam the witch's story was as follows.
Miriam was a witch affiliated with Nomad.
However, this was a matter that she wanted to settle without her colleagues finding out.
Miriam
「It seems like my familiar, Kuro, was taken by some weird guys.」
Miriam had two familiars, Shiro and Kuro.
At the time, both of them had left her to go out and play.
Miriam
「Going by what Shiro said, it seems like Kuro then got kidnapped by some strange guys wearing hoods――Right, Shiro?」
Shiro
「Kyuu!」
A strange creature floating in midair―Shiro the familiar―chirped excitedly.
It seemed that it had quickly hidden, and so had escaped without being captured by the strange group.
And then, having heard the story from Shiro, Miriam had been at a loss.
She was worried about the abducted Kuro.
However, if she consulted the people at Nomad about this, she would be made fun of for sure......
And so, Miriam had decided to entrust this matter to the detective who was rumoured to take on anything, depending on the money.
Clone Asagi
「I understand your story...... But I'm surprised that you're a witch.」
Clone Asagi
「I certainly didn't think that you were an ordinary girl, though.」
Miriam
「Fufu. Unlike that big lady over there, you must have a keen eye, to realize my greatness!」
Miriam
「My magical energy's a little reduced right now, but even so, I've got super-amazing power that won't lose to any sorcerer!」
She proudly puffed out her chest again, and Aki apologetically said,
Aki
「Is that so......? Well, sorry for treating you like a child earlier, Witch Miriam-dono.」
Aki
「You're just so tiny and cute, so...... well, my chest got all tight, saying 『I've got to protect her!』......」
Miriam
「Y-You......? You have some kind of weird fetish, or something......?」
Miriam
「Anyway, just as long as you understand! I hate being treated like a child, so be careful from now on!」
Aki
「Um-hmm, understood!」
Aki
「So, seeing as we've made up, could I, uhhh...... pat your head again......? Eheheh.」
Miriam
「You don't get it at all, do you?!! I can't take it anymore! Bite her, Shiro!!」
Shiro
「Grrrrr!!!」
Aki and Miriam began to cause an uproar.
Clone Asagi
While watching the two of them, Clone Asagi lightly breathed a sigh.
Five minutes later.
When they left the office, the rain had stopped.
Clone Asagi was walking through the plaza in front of the gate, with Aki and Miriam in tow.
Miriam
「Thanks for taking me on, Detective! I'll reward you handsomely!」
Clone Asagi
「Don't worry about it. I was just about to meet with an information dealer, so this is almost incidental.」
Miriam
「Hmm? Well, I don't care, as long as you find Kuro!」
The three of them were heading for an information dealer whom Clone Asagi was friendly with.
Before leaving the office, she had commissioned the information dealer to do another investigation.
About whether or not the abducted familiar had been put up for sale on the black market.
If they were lucky, they would probably be able to find it just from this investigation.
Clone Asagi
「But...... It's your own familiar, right? Can't you sense its whereabouts?」
She had heard that masters and familiars were connected by magical energy. In which case, she would have thought a witch would at least be able to tell its location. But,
Miriam
「Hmmm. Certainly, that little would be easy, under normal circumstances. But I can't manage it just at the moment.」
Clone Asagi
「What do you mean?」
Miriam
「Well, even I don't really understand it. I don't get it, but...... Lately, there's been a weird magical energy permeating the whole town area, see......?」
Miriam
「Kuro's presence has disappeared into that, and become completely invisible......」
Miriam said, while cocking her head in contemplation.
Clone Asagi
「Weird magical energy......?」
What did that mean?
There was no way Clone Asagi would understand, not being a mage, but...... Still, even she had definitely sensed an unsettling aura filling the plaza.
And then, Miriam turned in the opposite direction.
Miriam
「.........Incidentally, why are you here?」
Aki
「Me?」
Aki was also accompanying the two of them, with a face that said it was perfectly natural.
Aki
「Fufu. I know, I'm kind of like your guardian.」
Aki
「It's not safe around these parts. I have to protect Miriam-chan, so that no scoundrels show up to do naughty things to her!」
Miriam
「I told you, I'm a great, strong, distinguished witch!! Hey, Shiro, bite this big lady to death!」
Shiro
「Grrrrr!!」
The two of them began to make a racket in the middle of the street.
Clone Asagi
Clone Asagi
（I wonder if I shouldn't have taken the case......?）
The three of them arrived at a seedy bar on the outskirts of the downtown area.
This was the meeting place with the information dealer that Clone Asagi was friends with.
「Yo. You're here, then, cyborg detective.」
A man dressed like a refugee beckoned them to his table.
He was an information dealer named Tsukishima, who was highly valued throughout these parts.
Miriam
「Bit of a dirty-looking information dealer.」
Tsukishima
「Heeheehee, that's a good thing, young lady. If you look like a refugee, like so, you won't be suspicious, no matter where in the slums you are.」
Tsukishima
「Vice versa, if there's info somewhere that calls for a formal look, I'll dress for the occasion.」
Aki
「I see. Lots of idiots judge people by their appearance, after all, right?」
Miriam
「You were judging me pretty heavily by my appearance too, though......」
Having briefly exchanged greetings with the three of them, Tsukishima promptly got to the matter of their requests.
Tsukishima
「Now, shall we start with the simple one? The matter you just asked me to take care of.」
Clone Asagi
「You mean about her familiar, right? Well, was it put up on the black market?」
Tsukishima
「No, unfortunately. As far as I've looked, there is no record of that “familiar” thing being put up for sale.」
Clone Asagi
Miriam
「Mmm. A swing and a miss, huh......?」
It was disappointing, but it couldn't be helped.
This meant either that there was some other route employed, or that trafficking wasn't their aim in the first place.
Clone Asagi
「In that case, what about the suspicious group that this familiar saw?」
The hood-wearing group who looked like sorcerers, which the familiar Shiro had said it witnessed.
Tsukishima
「I can't tell you anything about that. There's too little information, but――」
Clone Asagi
「But? What?」
Tsukishima
「Heeheehee...... Let's leave that for later. It seems better to discuss all these things in order.」
Clone Asagi
「? What a tease...... Understood. Let's move on. This is about what I asked you for, right?」
Clone Asagi breathed a sigh, and urged him to go on.
Tsukishima was famous for only ever carrying out a conversation at his own pace.
The next topic was――about the bizarre incident that had occurred in the alley, which she was currently investigating.
Tsukishima
「This is the image data you requested. This was a pain to get, y'know? I was bowing my head all over the place.」
While smiling like he was expecting a debt of gratitude, Tsukishima flung a few dozen printed pictures at Clone Asagi's hands.
Aki
「Image data? What is it?」
Clone Asagi
「Security camera footage. To check whether there were any suspicious people hanging around the scene of the crime.」
She answered, while reviewing the images she had received.
In Yomihara, where law and order was at its absolute worst, the store owners and bosses of the various districts were highly conscious about self-defence.
As such, there was a surveillance network laid out to a certain extent, through cameras in the main streets and in front of stores.
Clone Asagi
（On the other hand, the slums and side streets that are outside of the surveillance network are total lawless areas.）
She had commissioned Tsukishima to procure image data from that.
Clone Asagi
「Well, the scene of the crime is away from the main streets, so I can't expect that much, though......」
The images she had been handed were shots of people passing by, picked out from that image data.
Even though it was late at night, there was a decent amount of foot traffic, and she couldn't narrow down who among it was suspicious.
“It'll take time, but there's no choice but to go over them one by one with a fine-tooth comb, huh......?”
Shiro
「Kyuuuuuu～～～～?!! Kyu, kyu kyuuu!!」
Suddenly, Shiro the familiar began to make a racket.
It indicated one of the pictures that had been spread across the surface of the table, and fluttered around above it excitedly.
Miriam
「Wh-What?! What's the matter all of a sudden, Shiro?!」
Shiro
「Kyu kyu! Kyuuu～!!」
Miriam
「Whaaat?! Is that true, Shiro?!!」
Clone Asagi
Aki
「What is it, Miriam-chan? What is that boy saying?」
Aki asked Miriam, who nodded repeatedly as she listened to Shiro's chirps.
Miriam
「Well, the thing is...... It seems the 『suspicious guys』 who kidnapped Kuro are in that photo......」
Aki
「Huh?!」
They hurriedly looked at the image that it had indicated.
There was indeed a glimpse of a strange group who appeared to be mages walking down the street.
Aki
「W-Wait a sec?! Why are we talking about the guys who kidnapped your familiar? That's got nothing to do with this case, right?!」
Tsukishima
「Well, not necessarily, as you might think. The thing I was going to tell you earlier was actually about those guys.」
Clone Asagi
「What do you mean......?」
Tsukishima formed a smug smile, and began to explain in a pompous manner.
Tsukishima
「In my case, I noticed them when I investigated the black market on your request.」
It seemed that, for the past several months, there had been a group buying up familiars, souls and magical beasts that were put on the market.
And in particular, they were choosing only to buy creatures which harboured strong magical power.
It was a truly bizarre, no-expense-spared cornering of the market.
Tsukishima
「That group are a bunch of fanatics who worship some crazy evil deity said to lead the world to ruin.」
Tsukishima
「As I recall, their name is the 『Order of the Abyssal Slumber』――」
Clone Asagi
「A group of fanatics......」
It was nothing that unusual. Here in Yomihara, there were lots of people like that who had screws loose in their heads.
Tsukishima
「Well, if that were all, I could have said, “Some crazy guys have started doing crazy stuff again,” and left it at that. However――」
Clone Asagi
「Their figures popped up in the surveillance footage......」
Tsukishima
「Heehee, bullseye――」
If that was the case, then it was a different story.
Tsukishima
「You know too, right? The sprite who was murdered over there was pregnant. And, the sprite's fetus――」
Clone Asagi
「......Would make for a powerful catalyst for black magic.」
Clone Asagi suddenly felt a chill.
Could they have kidnapped Kuro for the same reason that they had been buying up creatures with strong magical power?
The stronger the magical energy of the creature, the more powerful the magic it could be a catalyst for――
Tsukishima
「When you investigate with those two things in mind, you find something even more interesting.」
Tsukishima
「This past month, there have been a number of spirits, demonic beasts, even mages who have suddenly vanished, just like that young lady's familiar.」
Tsukishima
「Yomihara's a crazy town, so it hasn't caused much alarm, though......」
Tsukishima
「But what if that, too, was all 『their』 doing......? Heeheehee.」
Tsukishima
「Don't you get the feeling this incident we're seeing now is part of “something” much bigger......?」
Clone Asagi
Struck by an ominous feeling, she looked at the picture again.
Captured on camera were that suspicious group who looked like mages walking the streets, and――
At almost the same time, in the same place, a foreign-looking girl wearing strange attire.
Beneath Yomihara.
In the depths of an abandoned underground tunnel, there was a building.
『Ohhhmmm～～～～ aoooh～～ hooohuuunnh～～～～ mmmmm～～～～』
Chanting voices boomed.
The shadows of strange people wavered in candlelight.
Hooded sorcerers.
And bizarre creatures which were clearly unlike human beings.
A horrifying Otherworld god, sleeping dormant in the dimensional abyss――
Once again today, the people who worshipped it were about to commence a sinister “offering” ritual.
――Deeper within that vast building.
「Pih, piiih～～!!」
Gachan, gachagacha, dosah!
After ramming itself at it over and over again, something knocked its cage to the ground, and managed to crawl out through the opening that had been made in the process.
Kuro
Its round form floated up in midair.
It was Miriam's familiar, Kuro, which had been abducted by the strange group.
Kuro
「Pipih? Piiih～......」
Kuro trembled as it looked around, going, “Where am I?! What is this?!”
Immediately upon being kidnapped, it had been stuck in a cage, and had been imprisoned ever since.
Seeing an opportunity where there was no one around, it had finally managed to break free of its cage, but――
When it looked around again, it was in the kind of grotesque room that would give one chills.
Pods which appeared to be culture tanks were set up all over the place, casting an eerie light in the darkness.
Placed inside some of them were strange creatures which looked like a cross between a human and a fish,
And in others, hideous masses of flesh with tentacles growing from all over their bodies, which looked like they wouldn't even exist in the Demon World――
It was obviously a place where some kind of eccentric, heretical research was being conducted.
Kuro
“Scary! Way too scary......!”
“There's no telling what will happen to me if I'm caught in a place like this......”
While trembling with extreme fear, Kuro stealthily left that room behind.
Kuro
What lay ahead when it left the room was a vast chamber.
Signs of a large number of people stirring.
Apparently, they were doing something here, so they hadn't heard the sound of it breaking the cage.
Sorcerer
『Ooohhhhmmm～～～～ guuuaaaooooh～～～～ hooohhmm～～ kuunnn～～～ mmmmm～』
In the centre of them was a sorcerer.
He was reciting a strange, almost moaning chant.
In front of him was an ornate altar, with what appeared to be an aged black magic tome placed on it.
And then――
Sorcerer
He tilted the cup he held in his hands, dripping some thick, red, blood-like liquid onto the magic tome, and at that very moment,
――“HYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!”
Kuro
「Pipiih?!」
A bloodcurdlingly terrible cry rang out.
However, what had emitted that was the “book”.
Having had the thick liquid poured on it, a horrific roar had surged forth from the black magic tome's mouth, which it wasn't supposed to have――
And, as if to harmonize with that, space fissured, a rift opened up with a rumbling sound, and from the world on the other side of it――
Gogogogogogogogogo......!
“Something” enormous and horrifying was peering into this one.
Its utterly inhuman aura, that of indescribable “horror” itself, gradually ate away at this side.
Kuro
「Piiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiih～～～～～～～～～～～???!!」
Kuro flapped its wings in terror.
“Scary! Far too scary. That thing's really bad......”
“I have to escape from this place quickly, and get back to Mistress......”
「Intruder......? Suspicious...... Who......?」
Kuro
「Piiiiih????!」
All of a sudden, there was a girl standing in the way in front of it.
It was at its limit.
Kuro made a shriek, and lost consciousness on the spot.
At around the same time.
Gogogogogogogogogo......!!
Clone Asagi and the others were racing down a subterranean tunnel as a strange rumble reverberated.
According to Tsukishima's information, the aforementioned fanatics' base was at the end of this.
Aki
「But...... What the hell's that noise?!」
Miriam answered Aki's puzzled-sounding voice with an unusually tense expression.
Miriam
「I dunno, but...... I sense an amazing flow of magic power from down the way. What's going on......?!」
Clone Asagi
Even Clone Asagi, who was not a witch, could feel the tremendous magical energy which permeated the underground passage.
“Something abnormal is happening.”――
That hunch, verging on a conviction, hastened the legs of the trio running down the tunnel.
But then――
Clone Asagi
Gakiiiiin!!!
Clone Asagi's cyborg arm, which she had stuck out reflexively, was deflected by some hard, tentacle-like thing.
It was a head-on collision.
Just as they rounded a corner, they had bumped into a strange girl who had come running from the other side of it.
Clone Asagi
「The woman who was at the scene of the crime?!! Why are you here? Are you one of their number after all?!」
「Foe......? If foe, I retaliate......」
The girl muttered quietly, whereupon winding tentacles suddenly appeared from under her cloak.
Miriam
「h?! Wh-What's with the magic power of this girl? ――Wrong!! She's not human!」
Miriam looked at her in astonishment.
Clone Asagi
「Not human......? She's a demon?」
Miriam
「No, no!!! The fundamental nature of power between demons and humans isn't much different!」
Miriam
「This girl's on another level! She's not of this world...... She's probably a “thing” from another dimension......」
Aki
「Oh, really......?」
Aki smiled amusedly and drew her sword.
Aki
「And why would a certain someone from another dimension be in a place like this?」
「......Dangerous......... Beyond this point, no intrusion......」
Aki
What the girl said didn't make sense.
Her expression didn't change at all, and her words were fragmented, and extremely vague.
Nasara
「＠×％■, of world where Nasara used to be, awoken.」
Nasara
「Barrier, crumbles...... Many people die...... Ruin...... Danger......」
Clone Asagi
「Barrier? Ruin......?」
There was strange language in there, and they naturally couldn't grasp the meaning very well.
However, Clone Asagi recalled the aim of the fanatics, which Tsukishima had told her about.
『That group are a bunch of fanatics who worship some crazy evil deity said to lead the world to ruin.』――
In which case, was this girl a servant of the evil god they were said to worship......?
Aki
「Hmm. I don't really get it, but...... Could you stop blocking the way? We have something we need to do up ahead.」
Aki
「I don't know about this other dimension or whatever, but I don't want to hurt a cute girl.」
Nasara
The girl didn't move.
She was just waving her tentacles like she was on guard against the trio's movements.
Aki
Having seen that, Aki sighed resignedly and took a step forward, when
Kuro
「Piiiiiiiiiiiiiiih～～～～～～～～～～?!」
Miriam
「Kuro?! That's Kuro, isn't it?!」
A black figure flew out of the girl's cloak, and circled around and around over Miriam's head.
Miriam
「What?! She's not our enemy?! A good person?! You were saved by that girl when you were captured and scared......?!」
Aki
「Huh? What......?」
Clone Asagi
The other two relaxed due to Miriam's words.
And then――
Nasara
「Not foes? Then, vigilance rescinded......」
The Otherworld girl, Nasara, retracted her tentacles back into her cloak.
A few minutes later.
Nasara's words were fragmented and hard to understand.
Because of that, the situation was explained via the complicated procedure of conveying the story that Kuro had been told when it was rescued to the other two, through Miriam.
Miriam
「Um? So, what? Were you also trying to stop those guys' attempt to summon an evil god from the Otherworld?」
Nasara
「Affirmative. ＠×％■, dangerous. When it wakes, this world, perish.」
Nasara was an Otherworld creature who had come to this world from another dimension.
And what she called ＠×％■ was also originally a being from there.
（Incidentally, it seemed that ＠×％■ couldn't be pronounced properly in the languages of this world.）
Miriam
「It's what you'd call a dimensional invader, huh? I heard my mentor's mentor did battle with guys like that once upon a time.」
Nasara
「Yes. But Nasara, not aligned with that action.」
Nasara
「Many people, diverse lives, very interesting. Want to know more. Must not destroy......」
That was Nasara's reason for taking action.
Having gotten wind of the fanatics' activities, she had been working to try and stop them.
However, she had been counterattacked and run away from, so things had finally arrived at the worst-case scenario......
Aki
「Well, well! You're a crazy-good girl, aren't you?!! Sorry I tried to slice you earlier......」
Aki
「And so cute...... Ufufu. How about this? Want some candy?」
Miriam
「Why, you... Don't go fawning over everyone without a second thought...... This girl's an Otherworld creature!」
Nasara
「Candy? Lick-lick. Yummy. Informative.」
Miriam
「You're licking it?! You're surprisingly straightforward, aren't you......?」
Clone Asagi
Going by Nasara's story, it seemed that the dimensional invader had already started to penetrate this side.
And after putting Kuro, which she had found in their building, in a safe place, she herself had intended to fight to prevent that once again.
Clone Asagi
